bounded_conclusion: The current outside-Coastal RS-1-7 front-setback rule is supported as a conditional envelope, but the parcel-specific distance and structure compliance are not resolved.

conditions: No greater Fire Code Official buffer
Portion of lot fronts a cul-de-sac
At least one-half of the front 50 feet of lot depth has minimum slope gradient of 25 percent
Evaluated setback is closest to street frontage
Fire Code Official requires a greater defensible-space buffer

evidence_needed_to_select.fire: A project-specific Fire Code Official determination and supported airport-transition applicability.
evidence_needed_to_select.modifications: Project/document review sufficient to exclude or apply controlling setback modifications and programs.
evidence_needed_to_select.permission_election: A project-specific election of the permissive slope alternative.
evidence_needed_to_select.slope: Authoritative slope/topography measuring the literal Table 131-04D footnote 1 test across the front 50 feet of lot depth.

limitations: Compact repository evidence retains geometry hashes but not coordinates for a setback measurement
An additional boundary-touching outline is ambiguous in sealed linkage evidence

mandatory_qualifier: This evaluates only the front-setback rule envelope. It does not establish overall zoning compliance, legal nonconformity, a variance or violation, capacity, buildability, entitlement likelihood, or permit status.

measurement_doctrine.direction: Measured inward and perpendicular to the front property line (SDMC §113.0252(a)(1)).
measurement_doctrine.front_property_line: East boundary of PM 17383 Parcel 1 at the west edge of 27th Street public right-of-way.
required_inputs: authoritative current or proposed structure geometry
measurement_doctrine.setback_line: A line parallel to the nearest property line at the required inward distance; the intervening area is the required yard (SDMC §113.0249(a)).
measurement_doctrine.structure_edge: For new-development compliance, measured to the outer edge of the building frame (SDMC §113.0252(c)).

next_feasibility_source_target: authoritative slope/topography for the front 50 feet
non_cumulative_rule: The cul-de-sac reduction is from the table requirement and must not be subtracted from the six-foot slope permission.

accessory_structure_standard.basis: No proposed structure classification is supplied.

airport_transition_context.basis: No sealed airport transition-area determination was made for this parcel.
airport_transition_context.effect: Can affect applicability of the O-22109 fire-buffer provision.

alley_property_line_special_mapping.basis: The resolved front line abuts 27th Street public right-of-way, not an alley.
alley_property_line_special_mapping.effect: Does not remap this front line to a rear-yard standard.

application_complete_date.basis: This evaluator is expressly scoped to the current-version development profile and does not adjudicate a protected earlier application.
application_complete_date.effect: An earlier complete-application profile would require a separately versioned evaluation.

completely_underground_structure.effect: Completely underground construction has a separate setback treatment.

cul_de_sac_frontage_portion.basis: The recorded 27th Street frontage and centerline are straight survey lines with no curve, radius, or turnaround.
cul_de_sac_frontage_portion.effect: Excludes the §131.0443(a)(1) 10-foot permission for this parcel.

cul_de_sac_permission_elected.basis: The physical cul-de-sac predicate is false.
cul_de_sac_permission_elected.effect: No parcel branch may select this permission.

current_outside_coastal_profile.basis: Parcel Coastal mapping is supported OUTSIDE_COASTAL and the selected rule set is the current 9-2026 outside-Coastal profile.
current_outside_coastal_profile.effect: Selects the reviewed current outside-Coastal authority envelope.
current_outside_coastal_profile.source: Parcel Intelligence V2 + RS Base Standards V0

defined_steep_hillside_condition.basis: Table 131-04D footnote 1 states its own literal front-50-foot slope test; the separate Code-defined steep-hillside concept must not be substituted for it.
defined_steep_hillside_condition.effect: Does not select or alter the front-setback branch in this evaluator.

document_modified_setback.basis: The recorded map/deed chain resolves the lot but is not a complete search for every ordinance, survey, division plat, or approved subdivision setback modification.
document_modified_setback.effect: A controlling document can replace the base-zone setback line.
document_modified_setback.source: SDMC §113.0249(b)-(c) + Legal Lot Evidence V0 limitation

existing_primary_structure_addition.basis: No proposed project scope is supplied.
existing_primary_structure_addition.effect: Addition-specific established-setback rules remain outside this evaluation.

fire_official_defensible_space_buffer.basis: No project-specific Fire Code Official determination is in sealed evidence.
fire_official_defensible_space_buffer.effect: May require a buffer greater than the otherwise applicable base-zone setback.

front_50ft_fraction_at_least_25pct_slope.basis: No sealed authoritative topographic source measures the slope gradient across the front 50 feet of lot depth.
front_50ft_fraction_at_least_25pct_slope.effect: Controls availability of the Table 131-04D footnote 1 six-foot permission.
front_50ft_fraction_at_least_25pct_slope.source: Packet 14 condition inventory; no qualifying source

projection_or_encroachment.basis: No proposed building element is supplied.
projection_or_encroachment.effect: Permitted projections or encroachments can change which edge is tested.

property_line_roles.basis: PM 17383 Parcel 1 and §§113.0246(a)-(d) resolve the east boundary at 27th Street as the front property line.
property_line_roles.effect: Selects the front-setback family and its measurement origin.

required_street_or_alley_dedication.basis: The existing 30-foot dedication is accounted for, but no proposed-development dedication determination exists.
required_street_or_alley_dedication.effect: A future required dedication can change the measurement line for a proposed project.

resubdivided_corner_lot.basis: The legal-lot evaluation classifies Parcel 1 as single-frontage, interior, and non-corner.

setback_is_closest_to_street_frontage.basis: The evaluated line is the only Code front property line, at 27th Street.
setback_is_closest_to_street_frontage.effect: Satisfies the line-selection part of footnote 1.

slope_permission_elected.basis: The footnote is permissive and no proposed project or election is supplied.
slope_permission_elected.effect: Even a qualifying slope retains both the ordinary base and elected permission branches.

special_program_or_overlay_modification.basis: No project/program scope or complete overlay-specific modification review is supplied.
special_program_or_overlay_modification.effect: A separate applicable regulation may modify the base-zone envelope.
